quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West on his early Celtics career and Paul Pierce
quotes.excerpt: they put me in the backcourt starting with Paul Pierce right out of college.
quotes.quote: Ironically, we were playing my buddy Tony Allen. We matched up, me and him, head-to-head. We go to the final four. We both the top two teams in the country. Ironically, they draft me and him both first round, along with Al Jefferson, to go to the Celtics. When they putting teams together, they look at your go-to guy. You talking about those once in a lifetime generational type talents, like Paul Pierce. So they have a lot of say so on who they want to play with, or guys they can bring in to get something going. They put me in the backcourt starting with Paul Pierce right out of college. Played there for three years.

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: The trade involving Ray Allen, Jeff Green, and Kevin Durant
quotes.excerpt: If a team willing to trade Ray Allen for you, you got to, that's, you can't be nothing wrong with that.
quotes.quote: Seattle was forming a team around Kevin Durant. That's my young fellow, him and Mike Beasley come up out of Washington, D.C. They was trying to put a whole team around him. Ray Allen was in Seattle. Boston was trying to get Ray Allen. So, they weren't going to do the deal unless they could get Jeff Green and me in the deal for Ray Allen, which at the time, Ray Allen, he still is one of the best shooters to ever play the game. Him, Ray, Jermaine Miller, Steph Curry. If a team willing to trade Ray Allen for you, you can't be nothing wrong with that. Then they coming in to bring you in to play with Durant. So they had me and Coach Earl Watson and Luke Ridnour starting at the points. We switching up with Jeff Green and Kevin Durant at the two and the three. Letting them get his feet wet in the league and have guys that he grew up playing with.

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James recruiting Delonte West to the Cleveland Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I thought LeBron was pulling a veteran trick. I thought he was just trying to get me out of my game.
quotes.quote: We were playing Cleveland, out in Seattle, the first month of the season, and I was cooking them. I remember we were sitting at the foul line, and LeBron James, he was like, man, I followed you in college. You remember that time I came to Philly at the Palestra to watch you play? And I was like, yeah, I remember. He was like, man, you want to come play with Cleveland? I thought he was just doing a veteran trick. You know how sometimes you getting ready to check Jordan for the first time, you a rookie, and then you all for three nights straight, you just like, man, I'm going to show the world. And then at the jump ball tip, you sitting there breathing all hard, you standing next to Jordan, you like, I'm about to give him the business. And then Jordan pulled a veteran trick. He say, what's up, young fella? He say your whole name. What's up, Delonte West? He say, man, I followed you ever since you was in second grade, man. You the best player since sliced bread. I thought LeBron was pulling a veteran trick. I thought he was just trying to get me out of my game by getting familiarity. But he was serious. He asked me to come play with Cleveland.

quotes.quote: Did you play with Tyronn Lue in college? I talked to Tyronn the other day. He called me, checked up on me. We followed up. We had a good time laughing about the times in St. Joe's. He is doing well, doing well. He owns a shipping company out in Jersey, Philadelphia area. He called me the other day because I was back and forth on the phone with Coach Martelli about registering for classes and stuff like that. He was like, 'I got somebody who wants to talk to you.' Not Coach Martelli, but he be like, 'Come on baby, that Italian stuff. Got somebody who wants to talk to you, baby. Don't let me down.'

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West on Earl Boykins' unique ability to get around defenders
quotes.excerpt: Earl Boykins had a unique ability to get around you and just stop.
quotes.quote: Did you ever play against Earl Boykins? Oh man, Earl Boykins had a game. He had a unique ability to get around you and just stop. You know how like you walking and somebody got in front of you and they just keep stopping and you keep bumping into them? He had a unique ability to get around you and just stop and make you just fall right into him and get the and-one every time. I don't know how he did that stuff. He was nice with it.

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West on his experience shooting a pilot with Danno
quotes.excerpt: We were sitting and shooting a pilot for Netflix.
quotes.quote: When they came to DC, go to YouTube and look up Delonte West with Big 3. You will see I got the MVP of the camp when they came to DC. But I was like, you know, we were shooting a pilot for, well, my man Danno. I just had him on live the other day and we were sitting and shooting a pilot for Netflix. So they would come pick me up in the mornings to go work out in the gym, they film it, and then, you know, get ready, then, you know, we were supposed to do the, follow me around, so I could show them where I grew up and, like, kind of how they did Iverson, John on Netflix. The same people was involved. So, I would tell them in the mornings, you know, I need $20 for breakfast and stuff. That's all I need. So in the mornings, they would come around in the neighborhood and they had the camera people out and they meet me at the 7-Eleven and they be, and they give me the $20 bill and they be like, 'All right.' And they start getting the cameras out the trunk and getting the big old boxes, the camera boxes they open and shit. They'd see me, you would see me, you'd see me sliding around the side of the building. I'd be running out, every morning it never failed. I'd go to 7-Eleven and go get a six-pack of Corona or just get one like four Loco or 211. And you'd see me like, they'd be like, 'D, where you ready to go?' You'd see me take off running.
